tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineYiddish: דער קלוגער כתב-קוקער פאר שיעורים און חידושי תורה
releaseTitle: v1.1.0 — Multi-User Handwriting Profiles, Multi-Profile Stacking & One-Click Backup/Restore Studio
description: Ksav Kooker (כתב קוקער) v1.1.0 adds support for multi-user handwriting profiles, multi-profile stacking during OCR scans, and comprehensive backup, restore, and rule-merging tools. Each student, scribe, or book can have an isolated learning memory bank, switch on the fly from the top toolbar, or combine rules from multiple people in a single scan.
features: Multi-User Handwriting Profiles: Create, rename, duplicate, or delete isolated learning profiles for different people (e.g., individual students, rebbeim, or different notebook styles).
Instant Profile Switching: Switch active profiles on the fly directly from the top toolbar without restarting the application.
Multi-Profile Stacking: Check checkboxes in the profile manager to enable multiple profiles simultaneously; Ksav Kooker combines rules from all checked people during OCR scans.
One-Click Backup & Restore: Create timestamped .ksavbackup files with a single click, save backups to USB or cloud drives, and safely restore profiles.
Knowledge Merging: Seamlessly merge a colleague's or teacher's learned rules and abbreviations into your active profile without erasing your existing rules.
Optimized Package Size: Excluded unused sub-libraries, reducing memory footprint and download size.
100% Offline & Roaming Profile Compatible: Fully functional with zero internet connection; profiles roam seamlessly in Windows Server Active Directory domain environments.
